cohort: The study included 229 postnatal women, 4th-10th week postpartum, from the Singupuram rural health training centre area in Srikakulam district.
finding: The prevalence of postnatal depression was 28.3% and it was significantly associated with type of family, working status, husband's occupation, socio-economic status, mode of delivery, newborn gender, and pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed a significant association with postnatal depression.
